condo: Luxury Living Near East Coast – 2BR Amber Park

history.summary: Freehold 2BR (829sqft) at Amber Park, D15 East Coast, asking $3,076 PSF / $2.55M, 710m from Tanjong Katong MRT (TEL). Amber Park is a large, liquid 592-unit Far East freehold project (recently TOP'd) transacting ~$2,684-3,257 PSF, so this asking sits at the upper end of the recent range.
history.rating_rationale: Strong development: 592 units (deep liquidity), freehold, sea-fringe D15 lifestyle, and the new TEL Tanjong Katong/Marine Parade stations are real catalysts. But the $3,076 PSF asking is at the top of the verified ~$2,894 avg / up-to-$3,257 recent range, and the $2.55M quantum sits above the deepest-liquidity band — so you'd be buying near peak pricing. The location and liquidity are genuinely good; the stretched entry PSF balances it to Neutral.
